title: Context Matters: Improving LLM-Based Code Summarization with Hierarchical Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.18964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Source code documentation plays an important role in software quality activities, such as code review, program comprehension, maintenance, and bug fixing. However, it is often fragmented across individual code elements and focuses on local implementation details, providing little information about their surrounding context. This limits both developers' understanding of software systems and the effectiveness of Large Language Models (LLMs), whose reasoning is constrained by finite context windows. Enriching documentation with hierarchical context has the potential to improve software comprehension and support downstream, quality-related tasks for both developers and LLM-based tools. translated_title: 上下文很重要：利用层次化信息改进基于大语言模型的代码摘要
translated_abstract: 源代码文档在软件质量活动中扮演着重要角色，例如代码审查、程序理解、维护和缺陷修复。然而，文档往往分散在各个单独的代码元素中，并侧重于局部实现细节，几乎不提供有关其周围上下文的信息。这既限制了开发人员对软件系统的理解，也限制了大语言模型的有效性，因为大语言模型的推理受限于有限的上下文窗口。用层次化上下文来丰富文档，有可能改善软件理解，并为开发人员以及基于大语言模型的工具的下游质量相关任务提供支持。在本文中，我们提出了一项计算仿真研究，展示了增加上下文对生成代码级文档的影响，实验使用了多种大语言模型。通过改变大语言模型可见的函数、类和模块层次结构，我们评估是否……
tldr: 该论文通过向大语言模型提供函数、类和模块三个层次的上下文信息，验证了层次化上下文增强能够显著改进代码级文档摘要的生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that augmenting LLMs with hierarchical context across function, class, and module levels significantly improves the generation of code-level documentation summaries.
